name: Carbon Recall Tupelo
old_description: My system has been in for 11 months and has dramatically reduced my electric bill. The only "system maintenance" has been software upgrades by the manufacturer of the inverter.
about:
Carbon Recall Tupelo operates from Belden, Mississippi, serving the Tupelo area as a local solar and home energy company. The business operates under the Carbon Recall® brand and emphasizes its community roots, describing itself as a neighborhood team of mothers, fathers, friends, and neighbors working toward energy independence. No founding year or founder names are disclosed in public materials.

The company installs rooftop solar arrays and Smartflower® all-in-one solar systems, along with solar water heating, home battery storage, backup generators, EV charging stations, LED lighting, geothermal HVAC, and tankless water heating. It also provides whole-home energy efficiency assessments. All installations are performed by a team described as trained renewable energy experts, though facility size, headcount, and annual project volumes are not published.

Customers include both residential and commercial clients. Homeowners seek to lower or eliminate electric bills, with one testimonial noting a 60% reduction in grid energy needs after 11 months. Businesses are targeted for clean energy savings. The company assists with financing options, tax credits, and incentive programs to reduce upfront costs.

Carbon Recall Tupelo positions its differentiation on a community-first approach and comprehensive service bundle, stating it aims to make solar easy by handling design, permitting, installation, and incentive paperwork. The brand motto “Together, we improve lives®” reflects a stated mission to shape the future of energy one rooftop at a time.
